amazon-pay.title: Amazon bank-offer strip (live)
amazon-pay.headline: HDFC / ICICI / SBI / Axis instant discount tiles sit under Amazon Pay → Bank offers. They change by SKU and hour.
howToUse: Open the product → Coupons → Bank / Amazon Pay offers.
Match the exact card named on the tile.
If no tile, fall back to Amazon Pay ICICI 5% or Millennia/SBI Cashback card checkout.
hidden: Instant discount and statement cashback rarely stack. Read both lines.

pop.title: POPshop daily brands (live)
pop.headline: Brand % off and voucher tiles rotate. Open POP → Shop before you burn coins.
howToUse: POP → POPshop.
Check min cart, brand, and coin vs rupee split.
hidden: Joining-benefit vouchers expire on the date printed in POP.

cred.title: CRED Store this week (live)
cred.headline: Fashion / electronics / travel coupons are week-lot. Coin burn vs ₹ off is on each tile.
howToUse: CRED → Store.
Open the brand. Screenshot T&Cs if the cart is large.
hidden: CRED membership tier can gate the better coupons.

gpay.title: GPay promo chips (live)
gpay.headline: Bank-offer chips on bills and peer pay appear and vanish. They are not your card’s MITC rate.
howToUse: GPay → Promos / the bill screen.
Pay with the bank account the chip names.
hidden: A ₹100 GPay promo does not replace a 5% card offer on Amazon.

phonepe.title: PhonePe Rewards / Switch (live)
phonepe.headline: Gift cards and partner deals under Rewards and Switch. Caps and UPI-only rules sit on the tile.
howToUse: PhonePe → Rewards or Switch.
Read partner + min spend before you buy a voucher.
hidden: Voucher MCC is not Amazon.in Millennia 5%.

paytm.title: Paytm Movies / travel coupons (live)
paytm.headline: Codes and cashback on Paytm Movies and Travel are Paytm’s, not BookMyShow bank BOGO.
howToUse: Open Paytm Movies or Travel.
Apply the listed code. Prefer credit card if the tile allows — skip wallet load.
hidden: SBI Elite BMS BOGO is BookMyShow checkout, not Paytm Movies.

tata-neu.title: NeuPass & in-app banners (live)
tata-neu.headline: BigBasket, Croma, and Westside extra % sit as Neu banners. Plus vs Infinity slabs differ.
howToUse: Tata Neu home → offers.
Pay with Neu Plus/Infinity or Neu UPI ID as the banner states.
hidden: GPay-linked Neu Plus is still the 0.25% UPI base unless you use Neu UPI ID.

cheq.title: CheQ chip rate & voucher board (live)
cheq.headline: Chip % and voucher multipliers are on the CheQ pay/rewards screens. 1% is the usual pitch, not a law.
howToUse: CheQ → Pay bill to see chips you’ll earn.
Rewards tab for voucher vs bill-discount math.
hidden: If a convenience fee appears, subtract it from chip value before you switch from netbanking.

hdfc-millennia.title: Millennia 5% list — confirm this month
hdfc-millennia.headline: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, BookMyShow, Uber remain the usual 5% set. Shared monthly cap still applies. Not UPI, not Amazon Pay balance.
howToUse: Pay those merchants with Millennia as credit card.
Open HDFC MyCards / MITC if a merchant looks newly added or dropped.
hidden: Wallet load and gift cards stay excluded on typical months.

sbi-cashback.title: SBI Cashback 5% online — live exclusions
sbi-cashback.headline: Still the default 5% online card. Rent, wallet, utilities, fuel, insurance stay out. Amazon must be card checkout.
howToUse: Pay the website/app with SBI Cashback as credit card.
Skip UPI and wallet.
hidden: Merchant MCC can silently drop a site to 1%.

icici-amazon.title: Amazon Pay ICICI slabs this season
icici-amazon.headline: Prime 5% / non-Prime 3% on Amazon.in with this card is still the product. Partner billers ~2%. Confirm in Amazon Pay → this card.
howToUse: Amazon checkout → Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card.
hidden: Instant bank-offer tiles on a product can replace, not add to, this %.

hdfc-neu-plus.title: Neu Plus UPI cap — live
hdfc-neu-plus.headline: 0.25% any UPI app + 0.75% Tata Neu UPI ID, shared monthly NeuCoin cap (often 500). Fuel/wallet/rent/gov still 0%.
howToUse: Pay QR from Tata Neu UPI ID for the extra slab.
GPay/PhonePe/CRED = base 0.25% only.
hidden: Education via CRED/CheQ remains a common exclusion.
